exposure: High umbilical cord blood total IgE levels
outcome: Development of allergic diseases (nasal allergy, skin allergy, childhood asthma)
cohort: 500 infants born at Tishreen and Al-Assad University Hospitals between 2007-2015.
finding: High umbilical cord blood total IgE levels were associated with a higher prevalence of allergic diseases in children during an 8-year follow-up period.
birth_weight: Mentioned but not specified in abstract
